concepts.definition: a method of representing an object with separate perpendicular views such as front, plan, and side
a pictorial drawing in which the three principal axes are equally inclined and dimensions can be shown along them
the fixed ratio between a drawing measurement and the corresponding real measurement
the process of adding measurements and related information needed to define the size and position of features
a standardized style of line used to communicate a particular meaning on a technical drawing
a view that reveals internal features by imagining part of an object cut away
a horizontal view of an object or building as seen from above
a vertical view showing one face of an object or building
a drawing instrument used to construct circles and arcs or transfer distances
an instrument used to measure and construct angles
